pages.title: Technomancy
pages.text: The Technomancy school, with an Arcane Cog as its Focus, is centered around $(l)deployed constructs$() and maintaining them. Craft Arcane Cogs from copper, gold and redstone; a Clock also works as a Focus.

pages.title: Construct Synergy
pages.text: A $(item)Brass Sentry$() is a stationary turret that fires at nearby hostiles. Hit your own Sentry with $(item)Arc Welder$() to repair it, extend its lifetime and $(l)Overclock$() it, making it fire faster for a few seconds.

pages.title: Technomancy Rune
pages.text: Surround a Blank Rune with eight Technomancy Focus items. Runes upgrade wizard armor into the $(item)Clockwork Engineer$() set and become $(item)Technomancy Upgrade Orbs$().

pages.title: Clockwork Dynamo Staff
pages.text: A spinning cog-ring staff that empowers Technomancy and shortens cooldowns. It holds three staff modules.

pages.title: Overdrive Protocol
pages.text: Overdrive upgrades the $(l)next$() Technomancy spell you cast: Gear Barrage fires 5 piercing gears, Arc Welder forks to 2 extra foes, Steam Vent becomes superheated, Deploy Brass Sentry builds a twin-cannon $(item)Siege Sentry$() and Assemble Automaton builds a $(item)Mk.II$() war construct.

pages.title: Clockwork Automaton
pages.text: Rogue automatons punch hard and vent volleys of gears. Destroy them for Arcane Cogs and copper, or assemble your own with Assemble Automaton. Overdriven, it becomes a round $(item)Mk.II$() steam golem with Rocket Grab, Power Fist and a Static Field.

pages.title: Staff Modules
pages.text: $(l)Sneak + use$() the Clockwork Dynamo Staff to open its three sockets. Modules only upgrade Technomancy spells cast with the staff: $(item)Splitter$() (more projectiles), $(item)Caliber$() (bigger, stronger), $(item)Assembler$() (more constructs), $(item)Capacitor$() (cooldown, cast speed) and $(item)Tesla Coil$() (chain lightning). Tiers stack up to level 5 per family.

pages.title: The Tech Dragon
pages.text: Clockwork Shrines hide an altar; you can also craft one. Use an $(item)Overcharged Dynamo Core$() on it to wake the $(l)Tech Dragon$(): gear volleys, lightning breath, thunder storms, dive bombs and drone swarms, and a deadlier overcharged second phase.

pages.title: Clockwork Codex
pages.text: A 12-slot spellbook bound with Tech Dragon Cores: +15% Technomancy power, +5% spell power and +200 mana.
